info.name: Device Token & Language + Meeting Notifications
info.description: New endpoints for device token management, language preferences, and comprehensive meeting notifications

request.description:
Update Firebase device token anytime. Can be called after login or when token changes.

**Use Cases:**
- Update FCM token from mobile app
- User reinstalls app
- Device token expires
- Switching devices

**Parameters:**
- `device_token` (required): Firebase Cloud Messaging token

**Response:**
Returns user info with old/new token (masked)

Update notification language preference (English or Arabic).

When notifications are sent, the system will use the user's preferred language:
- EN (English): Uses `title` and `message` from templates
- AR (Arabic): Uses `title_ar` and `message_ar` from templates

**Parameters:**
- `language` (required): 'en' or 'ar'

**Response:**
Returns user info with old/new language

Get current device token and language settings for authenticated user.

**Response:**
Returns:
- `device_token`: First 20 chars + '...' (masked for security)
- `has_token`: Boolean indicating if token exists
- `language`: Current language preference (en or ar)

**Triggered:** When admin creates a new meeting
**Recipients:** Client
**Template:** meeting_created

**EN:**
- Title: "New Meeting Scheduled"
- Message: "Meeting {meeting_name} has been scheduled for {date} at {time}"

**AR:**
- Title: "اجتماع جديد مجدول"
- Message: "تم جدولة الاجتماع {meeting_name} لتاريخ {date} الساعة {time}"

**Firebase Data:**
```json
{
  "meeting_id": "5",
  "notification_type": "meeting_created",
  "language": "en"
}
```

**Triggered:** When admin updates meeting status
**Recipients:** Client
**Template:** meeting_status_updated / meeting_confirmed / meeting_completed / meeting_canceled

Different templates based on status:
- `waiting`/`request_sent` → uses `meeting_status_updated`
- `confirmed` → uses `meeting_confirmed` (specific message)
- `completed` → uses `meeting_completed`
- `canceled` → uses `meeting_canceled`

**EN:**
- Title: "Meeting Status Updated" (or status-specific)
- Message: "Meeting {meeting_name} status changed to: {status}"

**AR:**
- Title: "تحديث حالة الاجتماع"
- Message: "تم تغيير حالة الاجتماع {meeting_name} إلى: {status}"

**Status-Specific Variations:**

**CONFIRMED:**
- EN: "Your meeting {meeting_name} has been confirmed for {date} at {time}"
- AR: "تم تأكيد اجتماعك {meeting_name} في {date} الساعة {time}"

**COMPLETED:**
- EN: "Meeting {meeting_name} has been marked as completed"
- AR: "تم وضع علامة على الاجتماع {meeting_name} كمكتمل"

**CANCELED:**
- EN: "Meeting {meeting_name} has been canceled"
- AR: "تم إلغاء الاجتماع {meeting_name}"

item.name: Team Member Added to Meeting Notification

request.description:
**Triggered:** When admin adds a designer/marketer to a meeting
**Recipients:** The added team member (designer/marketer)
**Template:** meeting_team_member_added
**Endpoint:** POST /admin/meetings/{id}/team

**EN:**
- Title: "Assigned to Meeting"
- Message: "You have been assigned to meeting {meeting_name} on {date}"

**AR:**
- Title: "تعيينك في اجتماع"
- Message: "تم تعيينك في الاجتماع {meeting_name} في {date}"

**Firebase Data:**
```json
{
  "meeting_id": "5",
  "notification_type": "meeting_team_member_added",
  "language": "ar"
}
```

item.name: Team Member Removed from Meeting Notification

request.description:
**Triggered:** When admin removes a designer/marketer from a meeting
**Recipients:** The removed team member (designer/marketer)
**Template:** meeting_team_member_removed
**Endpoint:** DELETE /admin/meetings/{id}/team/{teamMemberId}

**EN:**
- Title: "Removed from Meeting"
- Message: "You have been removed from meeting {meeting_name}"

**AR:**
- Title: "إزالتك من اجتماع"
- Message: "تم إزالتك من الاجتماع {meeting_name}"

**Firebase Data:**
```json
{
  "meeting_id": "5",
  "notification_type": "meeting_team_member_removed",
  "language": "en"
}
```

**Triggered:** When admin calls sync-from-strategy endpoint
**Recipients:** All team members that are auto-synced from posts (designers/marketers)
**Template:** meeting_team_synced
**Endpoint:** POST /admin/meetings/{id}/team/sync-from-strategy

This endpoint extracts team members from PostTeamMember (posts assigned to the strategy order) and syncs them to the meeting.

**EN:**
- Title: "Team Auto-Synced"
- Message: "Team members have been automatically synced for meeting {meeting_name}"

**AR:**
- Title: "مزامنة الفريق التلقائية"
- Message: "تم مزامنة أعضاء الفريق تلقائياً للاجتماع {meeting_name}"

**Use Case:**
When a strategy order has multiple posts with assigned team members, call this to automatically add those team members to the meeting instead of manually adding each one.

**Firebase Data:**
```json
{
  "meeting_id": "5",
  "notification_type": "meeting_team_synced",
  "language": "ar"
}
```
